status: Implemented; build, focused, full default and Worker validation passed
change: Shared transformStringWithAdmission owns the output forecast for lower, upper, trim and substr in both row and vector evaluators. Casing reserves three UTF-16 units per input unit; trim and slice reserve input extent. This preserves existing vector admission bounds and brings scoped aggregate row expressions under the same contract without duplicate formulas.

cases: Row/vector result parity for Unicode expansions including sharp s, dotted I and ligatures
Supplementary characters and lone surrogates retain JavaScript semantics
Exact retained extent succeeds and one byte less rejects; disposal releases partial argument charges

limits: Native VM allocation and scratch are not measured by explicit reservation units.
Regex, date, spatial and comparison allocations, and scope integration in additional row evaluator call sites, remain open.
No throughput improvement is claimed by this sharing change.
